description: Poly Offset: adds a separate voltage to each channel of a polyphonic signal

params.text: The voltage added to the input channel of the same number, covering -10V to 10V until the menu is told otherwise; a knob numbered above the output channel count is ignored

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal the offsets are added to; a monophonic cable is copied to every output channel, and a channel with no input takes its knob voltage alone

outputs.text: Carries each input channel with its own knob voltage added; a display shows how many channels that is, yellow while that is at least the input count and red while it is fewer

menu: Offset range — 0-1 V, 0-2 V, 0-5 V, 0-10 V, +/- 1 V, +/- 2 V, +/- 5 V, +/- 10 V, or Custom, which adds Custom min and Custom max fields
Quantize — Off (Continuous), or rounding either the output or the offset to Integers (Octaves), to 1/12V (Semitones), or to a custom interval
Display unit — reads the knobs in volts or in cents
Polyphony channels — Auto follows the input, or 1 to 16 fixes the output channel count
